request: Source state readback for Vault/v8 deployment; report branch/sha/dirty count only.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
body=VAULT_V8_SOURCE_CHECK
for d in /home/admin1/projects/libral-vault /home/admin1/projects/astera_v8; do
 if [ ! -d "$d/.git" ] && [ ! -f "$d/.git" ]; then body="$body
$d|NO_GIT"; continue; fi
 sha=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD)
 br=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current)
 dirty=$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain | wc -l)
 body="$body
$d|$br|$sha|dirty=$dirty"
done
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'
